units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 108a">B. Bath. 108ᵃ</cite> (in Hebr. Diction). <he>הרחק חרדלך מדְּבוֹרְיִי</he> Rashi (ed. <he>מן דְּבוֹרָאִי</he>, Ms. F. a. R. <he>דבורי</he>) remove thy mustard plants from my bee-hive.
